title: Malicious code in @bellaxchan/wbails (npm)
description: The npm package @bellaxchan/wbails contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package may lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets and keys from a different, secure computer is strongly advised.
